title: The Brave Man's Bridge
text: A bridge of a single rope spans the gorge, fraying where it rubs the rock. Far below, white water thunders over stones. A sign hangs from the post: ONLY THE BRAVE MAY CROSS. THE REST MUST SWIM. Someone has drawn a skull beside it.

options.label: The bravest crosses the rope and makes it fast.

outcomes.text: A second rope, then a third. Everyone crosses dry, with the water roaring below.
The rope snaps halfway, and the water takes them, and spits them out on the rocks.
Cold to the bone, wet, and slower, and the river does not want to let go.

options.label: Burn the bridge so nothing follows.

outcomes.text: You swim, cursing the cold, but nothing follows you across.
